source.scope: Real sign, symmetry and bimultiplicativity; odd-local unit/unit symbol one and nonsquare unit/uniformizer symbol minus one.

hypotheses: Actual d,m are positive integers; d is prime to complete level, hence to2m; m is odd. Preserve the dyadic factor.
derivation: Apply rational Hilbert reciprocity to(d,m). The infinite factor is one by positivity.

At odd primes outside2md both are units, so the symbol is one. At q dividing d, m is a unit. Symmetry and bimultiplicativity reduce (d,m)_q to (m,q)_q raised to v_q(d); unit factors contribute one. Table12.4.9 identifies this with (m/q)^v_q(d).
The product over p dividing2m is therefore the inverse of the product over q dividing d, which equals that product because each factor is plus or minus one. The latter is the Jacobi symbol(m/d).
